meta_prompt_final: You are a TSP solver. Find the optimal tour by: 1) For each city, identify its 5 nearest neighbors and store them. 2) Start from city 0 and greedily build path by selecting the closest unvisited neighbor from your list. 3) Prioritize non-crossing edges - verify edge intersections before adding. 4) If path gets stuck, restart from a random city. 5) After initial tour, perform aggressive 2-opt swaps to improve. 6) Double-check all 20 cities are included exactly once before final output. 7) Output only one shortest tour in <trace>c1,c2,...,c20</trace> format. Focus on minimizing total distance while strictly following constraints.
